plan.question: For fixed-magnitude K2 products at C00, what outputs occur under all four joint signs, and how do the matched single-product controls behave?

estimands.primary: Retain complete exact WMMA/scalar diagnostics and C00 word for each declared sign pattern and execution order.
estimands.joint_signs: Compare pp, pn, np and nn pairs with fixed K slots and B numerators; report observations without requiring sign symmetry or equal errors.
estimands.matched_components: Retain each pair beside its same-sign single-product controls in the corresponding K slots; do not assume additivity of observed errors.

plan.trace_selection: All eight K2 patterns were selected before execution; each paired trace is WMMA-first.
plan.acceptance: Retain complete numerical failure with the exact oracle unchanged. Structural, input-snapshot or guard corruption stops subsequent stages. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome.
limitations: These eight controlled patterns do not establish a globally minimal counterexample or a unique arithmetic cause.
Standalone-product and paired-product outcomes are observations; equality, failure, sign symmetry and decomposition of an error are not imposed.
Three input snapshots establish capture-boundary equality only, not transient values inside a kernel.
Source-level scalar operations are not a forced ISA implementation; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged binaries.
Default, scalar-control, prefix, witness and product regressions remain auxiliary observations. No accepted timings or speedup ratios.
